    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(obj))
    sys.stdout.write("\\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()


def main():

new = '''def _write(payload):
    """Write one pre-serialised JSON document (UTF-8, ASCII in practice)."""
    out = sys.stdout.buffer
    out.write(payload)
    out.write(b"\\n")
